title: Choose Clarifi's visual world
question: Bolder re-roll, round 3. Six new foreign forms, the first dealt leads. Three hands shown so far with no steer; type one line in the steer box if you re-roll again. Lock one, re-roll, or keep the category standard (what ships today).

options.label: Lexicon Shoulder and Plate
options.lineage: nineteenth-century lexicon pages: fixed measure, shoulder margin, guide words, colour quarantined in a bordered plate
options.thesis: The statement is a lexicon: every line an entry at one measure, guide words naming the dates in view, and all colour locked inside one bordered plate, the bucket chart.
options.viewport: A head rule carries two guide words: the first and last date in view, recomputed as you scroll. Entries run at a 55-72 character measure, figures in mono in the machine voice. The shoulder margin is the bucket index, the current range struck through. The only colour on the page is the plate: a bordered figure of six bucket bars in seven-ink chromolithograph hues. A line moved by a new rule is struck and replaced, never faded.
options.risk: Bookish by default; if the plate is small or the serif carries figures, it reads as an antique and the money disappears into prose.

raised.raise: One chosen accent owns every live state; nothing else on the page is interactive colour.
A changed line restyles in place without breaking the grid; the cascade is visible, the layout never jumps.
A focused bucket owns the view: its entries swell to the full measure, the rest recede to the shoulder.
Share is a fill, not a number: solid at 100%, hatched at 50%, dotted at 0%.
Sorted lines stay struck by hand in the triage history, persisted locally.

regions.label: head rule: guide words 03 Oct — 28 Oct · Import
the plate: six bucket bars, only colour on the page

options.label: Metro Typographic Tiles
options.lineage: Metro: flat tiles and giant lowercase on black, headlines cropped off the edge, type as the whole interface
options.thesis: october in giant light lowercase cropped off the right edge; six flat tiles in bucket hues carry the figures; a tile flips when a rule changes its total.
options.viewport: One wide panorama slides behind the viewport: overview, lines, rules as panes, the next pane's header peeking in. Overview is a strict grid of square tiles, one per bucket, each a flat field of its hue with a giant figure. Press tilts the tile; a changed total flips it. No borders, no button chrome: tiles are the only doors.
options.case: Beats the leader on both axes: everyone has held this interface, and a flat tile with one giant figure is the clearest money readout on the table. Loses only in the lines list, where tiles give way to a plain ranked table on black.
options.risk: Reads as Windows Phone nostalgia if the tiles bevel, the type gains weight, or the panorama is replaced by tabs.

options.label: Split-flap Concourse Board
options.thesis: Lines are board rows ranked by date in fixed character cells; sorting a line flaps its bucket column letter by letter, conflicts light the amber lamp, excluded drops to dim red.
options.viewport: The whole statement as one ruled board: date, merchant, amount, share, bucket in fixed columns. Columns never move; only flaps change. Overview is a summary board above with six rows.
options.case: Beats the leader on audience: every traveller reads this board. Loses on clarity for the overview: a board ranks rows, it does not show proportion.
options.risk: Per-character flip animation on a 90-line month is noise; reduced motion must collapse to a single update.

options.label: Zoo and Gardens Guide Map
options.lineage: fold-out zoo guide maps: swelling lobes of flat colour, capsules as labels
options.thesis: Each bucket a lobe of flat colour sized by spend, coastlines between them doing all the dividing, capsules as controls.
options.viewport: One lobe dominates each screen; scrolling redraws the coast.
options.case: Loses both: a guide map is a day out, not a budget, and lobes show proportion but never a figure.
options.kept: A focused bucket owns the view; the rest recede.

options.label: Labanotation Score
options.lineage: dance notation: a vertical centre staff read upward, block length is duration, shading is level
options.thesis: Partner's column left, mine right, time flowing upward; each line a block whose height is its amount and whose fill is its share.
options.viewport: A centre staff with blocks flanking it, future above, count numerals in the margin.
options.case: Loses both: nobody reads a dance score, and reading time upward fights every statement ever printed.
options.kept: Share as fill: solid 100%, hatched 50%, dotted 0%.

options.label: Convention Circle Catalog
options.lineage: newsprint convention catalogs: hundreds of stamp-size cells, circled in biro, struck when visited
options.thesis: Every line a stamp-size cell in a numbered grid; the one you are sorting is circled in pen, sorted ones struck by hand.
options.viewport: A packed grid of transaction cells with a hall map keyed to bucket codes.
options.case: Loses both: a fan catalog is foreign to the household and stamp-size cells cannot hold a legible amount.
options.kept: Sorted lines stay struck by hand, persisted locally.
options.risk: Dense to the point of hostility.

canonCard.label: The category standard (what ships today)
canonCard.thesis: Modern consumer fintech at Revolut/Wise craft: pill nav, hero figure, group cards, lines list, light and dark by system.
canonCard.viewport: Month pills, headline figure, Spend and Put away cards, Over time bars, lines beneath.
canonCard.risk: Recognisably the category by design; that was the standing choice recorded in PRODUCT.md.
